notes.title: 2025 what to expect?
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! 
I hope you had a great 2025 entrance.

So like the title suggests, let's talk about what the plans for 2025 here on Steam are.

First, launch the demo as fast as possible. It's pratically done, almost at the stage of Steam approval so hopefully during January.

Second, have Act I ready. The plan is to have it ready in the first half of 2025, if everything goes as planned that's what's going to happen.

Third, release Act II, if everything goes as planned, during the second half of 2025.


That's it for now, enjoy.

notes.title: Early Access / Demo
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

The demo version is almost ready to play, the biggest changes you will notice are probably going to be visual but also to the gameplay. 

There will be improvements on the quality of the images and introduction to animations, if you never played this before, lucky you. Everything will be a surprise.

The game will have 3 modes.

[u][b]Full RPG experience[/b][/u]: This would be considered the most complete way to play, you will have maps to travel, secrets to find, figure out where to go and what to do, and of course, fight opponents and improve your skills. To sum it up, it's exploration and free roam in addition to the two modes below.

[u][b]Only combat [/b][/u]: In this mode, you will skip pretty much all the "traveling and exploration" but you will still have the battles with the opponents.

[u][b]Visual novel only[/b][/u]: This mode focus is to be a novel, it's solely based on the story and the choices you make, and doesn't require tactics or investigation from the player, all combats are auto wins.

 
[u][b]Full RPG experience[/b][/u] and [u][b]Only combat [/b][/u] will have a mode that allows you to skip the battles... Or not if you dare ;)


And now, let me show you some pics.

notes.title: Ataegina and Steam
notes.notes:
[h3]Hello all!

First things first, thank you all for being here. To be honest I didn't even realized there was a "news" section in the page until someone alerted me to it. My apologies.

[b]So I'll just tell you what I plan to do in the future right?

- Modernize/improve the graphical aspect of the game (Images, animations. UI)

- Add some more content storywise.

- Rethink the combat system.

- Music/Sounds.[/b]

You may ask, why is only Act I here, well it is for now. For structural reasons I decided to build them separatly, that allows players to play Act I while Act II is being polished. 

There's also a plan for a full game download after all is done, so unless I die or something like that don't worry about having only part of the game.

I think that's all for now. Thank you once again.

[i]Cheers!

Kthulian[/i][/h3]
